ingredients: 1/2 large head cabbage, cored and shredded

groups.title: Salad
items: 1/2 large head cabbage, cored and shredded

steps: Combine cabbage, green onions, almonds, and sesame seeds in a large bowl.
Make the dressing: whisk together sesame oil, rice vinegar, sugar, garlic, ginger, salt, and pepper until the sugar is dissolved.
Pour dressing over the cabbage mixture and toss until well combined.
